fields.label: Enable WATI Sending
fields.description: ADDON v2.0.2 — Global kill switch. Uncheck to pause ALL outgoing WhatsApp messages without disabling individual rules.

fields.label: API Token
fields.description: Bearer token from WATI API Docs page — stored encrypted

fields.label: Bulk Send Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Pause between each message in a bulk send to avoid WATI rate limits

fields.label: Max Retries on 429
fields.description: How many times to retry when WATI returns HTTP 429 (rate limited)

fields.label: Retry Wait (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds to wait before each retry after a 429 response

fields.label: Bulk Batch Size
fields.description: Max recipients per background-job batch during bulk send. Set to 0 to disable batching. Default: 100. BUG FIX: field was missing from JSON schema — present only via SQL patch, so there was no UI control to configure it.

fields.label: Log Retention (days)
fields.description: ADDON v2.0.2 — Wati Message Log entries older than this many days are deleted nightly at 02:00. Set to 0 to disable cleanup.

fields.label: Webhook Security
fields.description: FIX v2.0.3 — Protect the incoming webhook endpoint from unauthenticated flood requests.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Optional. When set, every incoming WATI webhook POST must carry a matching X-Wati-Secret header. Leave blank to disable verification (backward-compatible). Copy this value into WATI dashboard → Webhook → Custom Header: X-Wati-Secret. BUG FIX: changed from Password to Data — Password fields are Fernet-encrypted in Frappe v16 DB, making get_single_value() return ciphertext, breaking comparison.
